__broaden__.ἑὸν: ἑός — his own, her own (possessive, by-form of ὅς); neut. acc. sg., agreeing with δῶμα: ’his own’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with υἱόν: ’his own’
__broaden__.ἔλαυνε: ἐλαύνω — drive; impf. 3 sg., without the lengthened augment (= Attic ἤλαυνε): ’drove’ · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’drive’
__broaden__.ἔχ: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (ἔχ’ = ἔχε): ’held, kept’ · also pres. imper. 2 sg., elided (ἔχ’ = ἔχε): ’keep, hold’
__broaden__.ἧς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; fem. gen. sg.: ’whose’ (ἧς εἵνεκα ’for whose sake’) · also ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. gen. sg., agreeing with its noun (ἧς ἀλόχοιο ’his own wife’) · also relative, fem. gen. sg., attracted into the case of its antecedent: ’which’ (τῆς … γενεῆς ἧς ’the breed which’)
__broaden__.ὀρέξῃ: ὀρέγω — reach out, hold out, grant; aor. subj. 3 sg. act., in an indefinite relative clause: ’may grant’ · also aor. subj. 3 sg. in a condition, with ἄν or κε: ’should grant’
__broaden__.ὑπ: ὑπό (elided ὑπ’) — under, beneath; + gen.: ’from under’ (ὑπ’ ἀνθερεῶνος) · also + gen. of the agent or cause, ’under’ (ἀϋσάντων ὑπ’ Ἀχαιῶν ’as the Achaeans shouted’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπ’ Ἀδμήτῳ τέκε ’bore to Admetus’) · also + dat., ’under’ (ὑπ’ ἠελίῳ ’under the sun’) · also + acc. of motion, ’under’ (ὑπ’ ὀστέον ’under the bone’) · also + acc., ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἠῶ ’beneath the dawn’)
__broaden__.τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’ · also after ὅς, as an indirect interrogative: ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’ · also after εἰ: ’if anyone’ (εἴ τις …) · also after μή: ’lest any’ (μή τις Δαναῶν ’lest any of the Danaans’)
__broaden__.ἄνδρ: ἀνήρ — man; masc. acc. sg., elided (ἄνδρ’ = ἄνδρα) · also masc. acc. dual, elided (ἄνδρ’ = ἄνδρε): ’two men’
__broaden__.θῦνε: θύνω — rush, dart; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔθυνε) · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’rush’ (θῦνε διὰ προμάχων ’rush through the front-fighters’)
__broaden__.εὐρύοπα: εὐρύοπα — far-thundering, wide-sounding (epithet of Zeus; sense disputed); masc. acc. sg., epic short -α · also masc. nom. sg., epic short -α (εὐρύοπα Ζεύς ’far-thundering Zeus’)
__broaden__.ποικίλα: ποικίλος — many-coloured, intricately wrought; neut. nom. pl., agreeing with τεύχεα · also neut. acc. pl., agreeing with ἅρματα: ’intricate (chariot)’
__broaden__.πρὸς: πρός — towards, to; prep. + acc. · also + gen.: ’from, at the hands of’ (πρὸς Τρώων ’from the Trojans’) · also + gen. of witnesses: ’before, in the sight of’ (πρὸς θεῶν ’before the gods’) · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (πρὸς … ἔειπεν ’addressed’) · also adv., ’besides’ (πρὸς δ’ … ῥῆξε ’and besides … broke’)
__broaden__.ἕλοιτο: αἱρέω — take, choose; aor. opt. mid. 3 sg., potential with ἄν: ’would take, would choose’ · also aor. opt. mid. 3 sg. after μή, of fear: ’lest (he) take’ (μή τις … ἕλοιτο ’lest any take’)
__broaden__.ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj.; ἢ … ἤ ’either … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἐτεὸν … ἦε ’whether truly … or’) · also after πρίν, ’before’ (πρίν γ’ ἢ ’before …’)
__broaden__.πάρος: πάρος — before, formerly; adv.: ’once before’, with a finite verb · also with a participle: ’already, from before’ (πάρος μεμαυῖαν ’already eager’) · also correlative with πρίν, ’before (that)’ (πάρος … πρίν ’not … until’)
